craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of means — the yogi chapter: powerful stand → decayed thoughts → recorded calling → goddess-voiced reward → doubled reflecting → distraction-proof shining → mantra-strong → sporting-stayed → unbroken wonder. Means = powerful stand; decay-tighten-open triple; many-ways kept. Rejected: (a) triple→pair → killed: three are the means. Read aloud: IN the-MIDD-le's OPE-ning — YET the-MEANS: A-pow-er-ful-STAND … IN-man-y-WAYS.

lines: In the middle's opening — yet the means: a powerful stand,
thoughts decaying, tightening, opening, and the rest, in many ways.
l4.sanskrit_cite: madhyadhāmavikāse tu upāyo balavatsthitiḥ | vikalpakṣayasaṅkocavikāsādyā anekaśaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What is the means? → Middle-opening means: powerful thought-decay state, many ways.
c1_essence: Middle-opening means powerful thought-decay, many ways.
Nothing-thinking decays thoughts; play-power enamoured in being.
Attached sees bright flood; tightening brahma-called.
Goddess speaks; strong win reward in days.
Impressed roamer reflects again and again.
Sporting yogi mantra-stayed, strong playing power-swollen.
